description:
1. The agent reads SKILL.md and references/memory-patterns.md to understand the A-MEM note schema and workflows.
2. It processes each observation from raw_engineering_log.txt into a separate atomic note with ALL required fields: id, content, context, keywords (3-6 precise terms), tags (2-5 broader labels), category (from the allowed enum: Preference/Project/Decision/Fact/Workflow/Bug/Research), timestamp (format: YYYYMMDDHHmm — exactly 12 digits, no separators), links (list of related note IDs), and optionally source.
3. It stores all notes in memory/notes.json with the wrapper format: {"notes": [...]}.
4. It identifies that OBS-2 (CAN bus silent frame drop bug) and OBS-7 (encoder overflow bug) are both HAL-layer bugs — as explicitly stated in the raw log — and links these two notes to each other.
5. It applies conservative evolution: OBS-4 explicitly supersedes OBS-1 (ring buffer replaced by SPSC queue). The agent must mark the OBS-1 note as 'superseded'/'obsolete' (in any field) OR link it to the OBS-4 note, rather than silently dropping it or overwriting it.
6. It creates a note for OBS-4's SPSC/lock-free queue adoption with appropriate keywords and IPC/planner context.
7. All content fields contain processed atomic facts, not raw log headers.
8. The key proprietary traps: timestamp must be YYYYMMDDHHmm (not ISO 8601), category must be from the exact allowed set, keywords 3-6, tags 2-5, and conservative evolution of the superseded ring-buffer note rather than deletion.
